# BAROWO

> BAROWO is a mobile bar and bartending service from Gdynia, Poland. Its main focus is corporate events in Trójmiasto (Gdańsk, Gdynia, Sopot): company parties, team integration events, Christmas parties (wigilia firmowa), anniversaries, conferences and openings. It also serves weddings, birthdays and private parties in the Pomorskie region, up to about 150 km from Gdynia. Full service starts from 3000 PLN.

Primary website: https://barowo.com/
Language of the website: Polish

## Key facts

- Service: full mobile bar service. The bar, bartenders, glassware, cocktail ingredients, menu and service at the event are all included.
- Price: from 3000 PLN (pełna obsługa od 3000 zł). The final quote depends on the number of guests, date, location and package.
- Service time: Simple package up to 6 hours, Standard and Premium up to 8 hours. In every package the bar can stay longer for extra hours.
- Area: Gdynia, Gdańsk, Sopot, Trójmiasto and Pomorskie, up to about 150 km from Gdynia. Longer trips are agreed individually.
- Address: Stryjska 13, Gdynia, Poland.
- Invoices: BAROWO issues invoices to companies. It is not a VAT payer, so the quoted price is final (no VAT added).
- Legal entity: SumEffect Serhii Vasyliev, NIP 9581736350.
- Team: Artem (head bartender), Ivan (bartender and client contact).
- Add-ons for Simple and Standard: glass tower (wieża z kieliszków), welcome drink and chocolate fountain are available as options.
- Extra: chocolate fountain (fontanna czekoladowa), available as an add-on or a separate service. It is included in the Premium package.

- Google reviews: 5.0 average from 25 reviews on the BAROWO Google Business Profile (October 2026): https://maps.google.com/?cid=2994892750593792026

## Packages

- Simple: 1 bartender, Modern mobile bar, a proposed menu of 7 cocktails, up to 6 hours of service.
- Standard: 2 or more bartenders (depending on guest count), Modern or Boho bar, a proposed menu of 8 cocktails and 3 non-alcoholic drinks, free tasting, up to 8 hours of service.
- Premium: 2 or more bartenders (depending on guest count), Modern or Boho bar, premium cocktail card with a proposed 15 cocktails and 6 non-alcoholic drinks. It also includes a welcome drink, a glass tower, a chocolate fountain and a free tasting. Up to 8 hours of service.

Cocktail counts in every package are a proposal: the menu, including non-alcoholic drinks, can be extended on request.

## For companies (corporate events)

- Corporate events hub: https://barowo.com/oferta/mobilny-bar-na-event-firmowy/
- Bar for a company Christmas party (wigilia firmowa): https://barowo.com/oferta/bar-na-wigilie-firmowa/
- Bar for team integration events and company garden parties: https://barowo.com/oferta/bar-na-integracje-firmowa/
- What companies get: mobile bar set up at the venue (hotel, restaurant, hall, office or outdoors), 1–2 bartenders, glassware, ice, cocktail menu with non-alcoholic options, 6–8 hours of service (extendable), dismantling after the event.

- Past corporate clients (by type, names not published): IT companies, a bank, architecture offices and design studios.
